stem: The Planet Mercury is revolving around the Sun in an elliptical orbit, as shown in the given figure. The Kinetic energy of Mercury is greatest at the point labelled.
expl: The closer a planet is to the sun, the stronger the sun's gravitational pull on it. Thus, the planet moves faster.

stem: Which of the following planet takes the least time to orbit the sun?
expl: The planet Mercury takes the least time to complete one rotation around the sun. The time taken by all eight planets to complete one revolution around the sun is as follows – Mercury - 88 Days Venus - 224.7 Days Earth - 365.2 Days Mars - 687 Days Jupiter - 11.86 Years Saturn - 29.4 Years Uranus - 84.07 Years Neptune - 164.9 Years

stem: Which of the following pairs of planets is without satellites?
expl: Venus and Mercury are the only planets in the solar system that do not have any natural satellites or moons, while Earth has 1 moon, Mars-2 moons, Jupiter-95 moons, Saturn-146 moons, Uranus- 27 moons and Neptune has 14 moons.

stem:
Consider the following statements :
1. The albedo of an object determines its visual brightness when viewed with reflected light.
2. The albedo of Mercury is much greater than the albedo of the Earth.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
expl: The term albedo is commonly used to describe the reflective properties of planets Satellites and asteroids Planet. Mercury receives greater sunlight in comparison to Earth but its albedo is less than that of Earth. The albedo of Mercury is approx 0.1 while the albedo of Earth, it is approx. 0.3. Thus, only the first statement is true that is why option (a) is correct.
